# 08-persistence-becomes-pets.png — prompt

Style (shared series system): landscape 16:9 (1672x941). Warm off-white paper background, charcoal typography and outlines. Accents only from: cobalt blue, vermilion, teal, mustard. Crisp geometric editorial illustration, subtle depth, generous negative space. Minimal LARGE text labels exactly as quoted; icons carry secondary meaning. Causal arrows and containment boundaries. Avoid: dashboards, ornamental circuitry, photorealism, tiny labels, decorative AI glow.

Composition: a left-to-right timeline of one sprite box across four stages. Stage 1 "PROVISIONED ONCE" — clean teal box, checklist stamp. Stage 2 "UPDATE = SURGERY" — same box now running (small heartbeat line), a wrench and a hand reaching INSIDE it mid-operation, charcoal hatching suggesting risk. Stage 3 "DRIFT" — a small fleet of three boxes behind it, one green-checked, one mustard "STALE ENV", one vermilion "PARTIAL"; the boxes are no longer identical (slightly different heights/patches). Stage 4 "THE RELIABLE PATH" — the old box faded toward a small grave/recycle mark and a fresh clean box being stamped anew, labeled "DELETE + REPROVISION". Top caption: "PERSISTENCE WITHOUT A REBUILD RECIPE TURNS CATTLE INTO PETS". Keep it wry, not grim.
